issue_request: FHIR-33231 was Published as Persuasive. It asked how to indicate video versus audio participation in telehealth encounters, and the final PA resolution explicitly extended the FHIR-33341 virtual-service structure to Encounter.
initial_application: Git commit 4d515864f46e10b648e02e76cd8773d8636c6d07 added Encounter.virtualService with type VirtualServiceDetail and copied the FHIR-33341 virtual-meeting guidance, but the copied participant-specific sentence still named VirtualServiceContactDetail.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Encounter and VirtualServiceDetail. Searches found no VirtualServiceContactDetail definition in core source or the Extension Pack. PA May 2022 WGM minutes state FHIR-33231 was directly related to approved FHIR-33341 work and approved the compatible Encounter change 8-0-0.
reconciliation: Changed only source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml so the Encounter.virtualService comment recommends an extension using VirtualServiceDetail for participant-specific meeting links.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: updated the Encounter.virtualService comment from VirtualServiceContactDetail to VirtualServiceDetail for participant-level extension guidance.
